title: New Friendslop Project
author: Claude_human_4271
selftext:
[Director Must Cut by ParadogsEntertainment](https://paradogsentertainment.itch.io/director-must-cut)

I took part in the Epic Games MegaJam 2026 and had to come up with a concept for the theme "Directors Cut" and being the brainrotted vibe coder that I am I made a friendslop game about a director that cuts you into pieces, but the pieces can attach to other players pieces and survive as long as your head remains intact!

  
I had damn fun doing it, and I released my dev blog as well in the link in case someone wants to have an AI summarize it for them for anything to borrow :D

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Claude_human_4271 please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.
